SELECT "id", "proposal_code", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "supplier_id", "status", "urgency", "owner_id", "requested_qty", "suggested_qty", "unit_cost", "estimated_total", "confidence_score", "needed_by_date", "approved_at", "rationale", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:replenishment_proposals}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("proposal_code"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("rationale"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'proposal_code' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "proposal_code" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'proposal_code' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "proposal_code" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'requested_qty' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "requested_qty" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'requested_qty' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "requested_qty" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'suggested_qty' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "suggested_qty" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'suggested_qty' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "suggested_qty" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'unit_cost' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "unit_cost" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'unit_cost' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "unit_cost" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "proposal_code", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "supplier_id", "status", "urgency", "owner_id", "requested_qty", "suggested_qty", "unit_cost", "estimated_total", "confidence_score", "needed_by_date", "approved_at", "rationale", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:replenishment_proposals}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("proposal_code"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("rationale"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($3::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "proposal_code", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "supplier_id", "status", "urgency", "owner_id", "requested_qty", "suggested_qty", "unit_cost", "estimated_total", "confidence_score", "needed_by_date", "approved_at", "rationale", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:replenishment_proposals}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:replenishment_proposals}} ("proposal_code", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "supplier_id", "status", "urgency", "owner_id", "requested_qty", "suggested_qty", "unit_cost", "estimated_total", "confidence_score", "needed_by_date", "approved_at", "rationale", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::int, $3::int, $4::int, $5::text, $6::text, $7::int, $8::int, $9::int, $10::numeric, $11::numeric, $12::int, $13::date, $14::timestamptz, $15::text, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "proposal_code", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "supplier_id", "status", "urgency", "owner_id", "requested_qty", "suggested_qty", "unit_cost", "estimated_total", "confidence_score", "needed_by_date", "approved_at", "rationale", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:replenishment_proposals}}
SET "proposal_code" = $2::text, "sku_id" = $3::int, "warehouse_id" = $4::int, "supplier_id" = $5::int, "status" = $6::text, "urgency" = $7::text, "owner_id" = $8::int, "requested_qty" = $9::int, "suggested_qty" = $10::int, "unit_cost" = $11::numeric, "estimated_total" = $12::numeric, "confidence_score" = $13::int, "needed_by_date" = $14::date, "approved_at" = $15::timestamptz, "rationale" = $16::text, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "proposal_code", "sku_id", "warehouse_id", "supplier_id", "status", "urgency", "owner_id", "requested_qty", "suggested_qty", "unit_cost", "estimated_total", "confidence_score", "needed_by_date", "approved_at", "rationale", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:replenishment_proposals}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:replenishment_proposals}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:replenishment_proposals}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"

SELECT count(*)::int AS total, coalesce(sum("unit_cost"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total_value, coalesce(avg("unit_cost"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS average_value, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'draft')::int AS status_draft, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'pending_approval')::int AS status_pending_approval, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'approved')::int AS status_approved, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'ordered')::int AS status_ordered, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'received')::int AS status_received, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'cancelled')::int AS status_cancelled
FROM {{table:replenishment_proposals}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at)::date AS day, count(*)::int AS count, coalesce(sum("unit_cost"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total
FROM {{table:replenishment_proposals}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= coalesce(NULLIF($1::text, '')::date, now() - interval '90 days')
  AND created_at < (coalesce(NULLIF($2::text, '')::date, now()::date) + interval '1 day')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "status" AS status, count(*)::int AS count FROM {{table:replenishment_proposals}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date) AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
